title: The incredible Costa Brava
text: I had an incredible experience on the Costa Brava with the best tour guide, Marcos. We went kayaking through the canals, cliff jumping, and snorkeling, all accompanied by excellent music from Argentina. I highly recommend this excursion and Marcos.
author: Passport32982258198

title: An unforgettable experience
text: My best experience in Barcelona. Marcos was a great and helpful guide. A relaxing canoe trip, jumping off a cliff into the water, snorkeling—everything was optional and laid-back. 7 hours total including transport. There were six of us in the group, and everyone had a great time. I highly recommend it.
author: Adamovsky

title: Amazing organization, great energy and fun memories!
text: Marco was an amazing guide made sure to make everything safe and fun!
author: Explorer826041

title: Fantastic
text: Highly recommended experience! The kayak activity was very fun and everything was very well organized. Special mention to Marcos, the instructor, who was very kind, attentive and professional at all times, explaining everything clearly and making the experience even better. You can tell that he enjoys his work and that he cares about everyone having a good time. I would do it again without a doubt!
